market_summary: US stocks reversed lower on Thu Nov 19 after an early lift from Anthropic's Nasdaq debut (priced $83, opened $111.50, ~$81bn raised); the Dow was down about 1,000 points midday with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also falling. The S&P 500 had already closed lower five straight sessions to Nov 18, its longest losing run since June, as AI names swung despite Nvidia's beat (revenue ~$115.8bn, +103%). Futures price ~92% odds of a quarter-point Fed hike in December; the 10-year sits near 5.06% and Brent eased to about $92. Walmart lifted guidance only modestly. No confirmed outcome from the Trump-Xi APEC meeting in Shenzhen had been reported at time of writing.

headlines: Anthropic opened 34% above its $83 IPO price, then faded to about +18% by midday.
Stocks reversed lower midday Nov 19; Dow down about 1,000 points, holdings mostly down 1-3%.
Alibaba cloud revenue up 53% but EPS missed; shares about +1% midday.
AMD fell 9% on a short-seller China report; BofA dropped Vertiv from its US 1 List.
Fed December hike about 92% priced; PCE and GDP due Nov 25 (Thu morning AEDT).
